body: on the back: “friday at closing, silver specks in the weathered bundle after the feed test. the ditch smelled metallic. later, the noon siren sounded.”
title: weathered bundle note — friday at closing
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the silver specks while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.

title: Burning the old directions
body: The ranger had given us a route out and said to keep the slip clean. A second ranger came before dark and told us the route had never been assigned. We used the old slip for tinder, except this corner with my mother’s name.
rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
